note: Hand-curated public sources (read via web search on the access date, no login). Numbers quoted are the SOURCE's claims; third-party Etsy keyword volumes are modeled ESTIMATES (Etsy does not publish search counts).

sources.title: Seller Trend Report: Fall and Winter 2025
sources.type: official Etsy report (Etsy search/sales data as of Sep 2, 2025)
sources.finding: Holiday gifting themes: personalized & sentimental gifts for family/milestones, elevated entertaining for hosts, playful/nostalgic pieces, cozy home updates. Rising: table settings +1,000%, engraved cutting boards +60%, maximalist prints tripled.

sources.title: Etsy Success: Your Holiday Merchandising Guide
sources.finding: Holiday shoppers search by gift type, price and RECIPIENT; personalization (name, initial, location like state) is a perennial favorite.

sources.title: 2026 Holiday Trends for Etsy Sellers: Ideas & Keywords
sources.finding: Get holiday listings live early; later shoppers search specific recipients and stocking fillers. 'Christmas' still had 17,760 Etsy searches in January 2026 (eRank estimate).
